title: matricaria macrophylla
intro: Matricaria macrophylla, commonly known as large leaved chamomile, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This herb has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Matricaria macrophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues, calming anxiety, and promoting relaxation. Regular consumption of Matricaria macrophylla may also help to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
